phone.text: Oga is outside. Black Prado. Come down. - Musa

beats.text: 7:00pm. A tinted Prado slides to a stop outside your gate. Nobody gets out.
The back window lowers halfway. A gold Rolex. A red cap. A smile you can only half see.
So you're the one Musa told me about. Get in. Ikoyi is waiting.
The window stays half down. Like everything with him, you'll only ever see part of it.
